events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: An exclusive Brisbane showing of major immersive works by Olafur Eliasson exploring light, colour, perception and sensory experience. Large-scale installations and a meticulously constructed riverbed invite you to move through each moment in succession, experiencing the work as it unfolds. A world-class contemporary art exhibition genuinely worth multiple visits.
events.why: One of the world's leading contemporary artists' first major Australian retrospective — genuinely unmissable if you care about how art engages the senses and transforms space.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights – Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: Extended gallery hours with Eliasson exhibition plus live DJs in the River Room, vinyl listening bar with rotating Brisbane selectors, live performances across the space, and bespoke bars serving drinks and food. A curated night blending art, music and social connection in one of Brisbane's most beautiful venues.
events.why: Combines world-class art with live music and a genuinely social atmosphere — the kind of evening where you experience both the exhibition and the crowd.

events.title: Make A Scene — LGBTQ+ 90s Australian Queer Culture
events.description: An immersive free exhibition celebrating iconic 90s LGBTQIA+ identity, nightclub culture, fashion and Brisbane-based labels that defined the era. Features personal stories, fashion-forward expressions, and the underground dance party scene coinciding with the 35th anniversary of decriminalisation of homosexuality. Glamorous, moving, and genuinely community-centred.
events.why: A rare free exhibition celebrating authentic subculture and local queer history with personal stories and radical fashion — exactly the kind of community-grounded art event worth attending.

events.title: The Drover's Wife – The Opera (World Premiere)
events.description: A world premiere opera based on Leah Purcell AM's play, novel and film, featuring a ravishing original score by George Palmer AM performed live by Queensland Symphony Orchestra. This monumental new work reveals the symphonic soul of Purcell's modern classic in its most expansive telling yet.
events.why: A world premiere of an Australian cultural moment — seeing a new opera by a leading Australian artist in its first season is genuinely extraordinary.

events.title: Brisbane Theosophical Society – Weekly Lecture Series
events.description: Recurring Wednesday evening public lectures exploring philosophy, consciousness and Eastern/Western wisdom traditions. A thoughtful, welcoming community for those interested in expanding understanding of human potential, ageless wisdom and spiritual growth. Part of a global theosophical movement with serious intellectual roots.
events.why: A genuine recurring intellectual community focused on serious philosophy and consciousness — the kind of space where thoughtful people naturally gather and discuss big ideas.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.location: Redlands Coast, ~40 km east of Brisbane CBD
events.description: A 10-day outdoor adventure festival featuring hiking, mountain biking, trail running, family activities and outdoor experiences across the Redlands Coast. An authentic regional festival celebrating outdoor adventure and nature beyond the city.
events.why: A full-fledged adventure festival right on Brisbane's doorstep with diverse outdoor activities — perfect for exploring local nature and meeting fellow adventurers.

events.title: Weaving is Healing – Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens
events.description: A hands-on immersive workshop teaching Figure 8 coil weaving technique (with roots in African and European traditions) in a ceremony-style healing circle. Create a basketling while learning a meditative craft in a beautiful natural garden setting. Grounded, creative, and genuinely therapeutic without cult-like spirituality.
events.why: A rare opportunity to learn traditional weaving in a beautiful garden setting within an intentional healing community circle — authentic craft with grounded philosophy.

events.title: The Yellow Diary – Live in Brisbane
events.description: An indie South Asian act with a devoted international following brings an atmospheric live music performance to Wonderland Brisbane, followed by an exclusive Bollywood Club Night after-party. A niche, genuine music community event rather than mainstream concert.
events.why: A genuine indie music community with authentic devotion to the artist — the kind of intimate live experience where the crowd itself becomes part of the atmosphere.

events.title: Brisbane Social Geeks – Philosophy, Board Games & Intellectual Discussion
events.description: A recurring community group for curious, socially-minded people focused on enlarging social connections and developing mind and body. Events include philosophical discussions, board gaming nights, guided meditation and yoga. A genuinely welcoming space for intellectually engaged locals.
events.why: A long-running recurring group specifically designed for thoughtful people to meet and discuss ideas — exactly the kind of natural conversation community the user seeks.

events.title: Australian Cinémathèque – 'Double Take' Film Program
events.datetime: Various screenings 1 May–1 Jul 2026 (check QAGOMA for May dates)
events.description: A curated film season running alongside the Eliasson exhibition, featuring works from visionary directors including David Lynch. A curatorial program pairing cinema with contemporary visual art — the kind of thoughtful programming that attracts serious film enthusiasts.
events.why: A curated film program alongside world-class art exhibitions — attracts the kind of intellectually engaged cinema audience you'll want to know.

events.title: QSO Italian Gala
events.description: Queensland Symphony Orchestra under Chief Conductor Umberto Clerici performs a rich program drawing from Italian opera and film, capturing the spirit of Italian classical music and cinematic scores. A grand orchestral evening with passionate classical repertoire.
events.why: A solid orchestral evening with Italian classical heritage — good for those who enjoy live orchestral music, though less exploratory than experimental or unusual programming.

events.title: Claire Hooper: fun show xx – Brisbane Comedy Festival
events.description: A warm, witty solo comedy show from Claire Hooper exploring the paradox of someone who wants to have fun but is the least fun person she knows. Involves lists, self-discovery, energy and sweat. A thoughtful, character-driven comedy performance.
events.why: Character-driven comedy at a respected venue — the kind of thoughtful solo show that tends to attract curious, intelligent audiences.

events.title: Pete Helliar: Was I Offside? – Brisbane Comedy Festival
events.description: A hilarious true-story comedy show about a viral media incident when Pete Helliar makes a cheeky joke about ISIS during a live TV interview with Tim Cahill before a World Cup qualifier. A wild, absurdist deep dive into intent, outrage, and the power of one punchline.
events.why: A genuinely unusual comedy premise grounded in a real incident — the kind of narrative-driven solo show that attracts thoughtful audiences.

events.title: Brisbane Azure User Group – Monthly Meetup
events.description: A recurring monthly technical community meeting for those interested in Microsoft Azure cloud platform. Features technical talks, demos and genuine peer community from practising engineers and technologists. Second Wednesday evening of every month.
events.why: A genuine technical community (not corporate marketing) where practitioners discuss real tools — useful if cloud computing interests you.

events.title: AI & Society — Brisbane Meetup
events.description: A community meetup exploring the intersections of artificial intelligence, ethics and society. An early-morning gathering for curious minds interested in how AI shapes the future and its philosophical implications.
events.why: A community forum specifically pairing AI with ethics and societal impact — attracts people thinking beyond hype.

events.title: Brisbane Riverside Social Walkers – Thursday Evening
events.location: Brisbane Riverside (check Meetup for start point)
events.description: A recurring after-work riverside walk with a welcoming community of active locals. Scenic, social, low-pressure way to exercise and meet people who enjoy being outdoors.
events.why: A genuinely social recurring outdoor community — the kind of low-key event where people naturally talk and connections form.

events.title: Brisbane Riverside Social Walkers – Saturday Morning
events.location: Brisbane Riverside (check Meetup for start point)
events.description: Weekend morning riverside walk with the same welcoming community. Relaxed, scenic, social gathering for active people to meet and enjoy Brisbane's natural setting.
events.why: Same community as the Thursday walk but in daylight — accessible weekend option for meeting fellow active locals.

events.title: Brisbane Riverside Social Walkers – Sunday Morning
events.location: Brisbane Riverside (check Meetup for start point)
events.description: Sunday morning riverside walk continuing the weekly community tradition. Meet friendly, active locals in a scenic riverside setting with natural conversation opportunities.
events.why: A consistent weekend option in an authentic outdoor community — good for meeting active, friendly people without pressure.

events.title: GOMA Kids Tour – Presence & Play
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Bank
events.description: A family-focused guided tour of the Olafur Eliasson exhibition designed for children, exploring art through play and sensory engagement in a relaxed, crowd-free pre-opening setting. Multi-sensory, imaginative, and genuinely thoughtful rather than superficial.
events.why: A rare chance to experience world-class art in a calm, thoughtfully-designed family setting before crowds arrive.

events.title: Dog Lovers Festival Brisbane
events.description: Queensland's biggest celebration of dogs with community-oriented activities at Brisbane Showgrounds. A genuinely social festival designed for dog lovers and owners to meet, celebrate, and connect around shared passion.
events.why: A large community-focused festival — good if you have genuine love for dogs and want to meet fellow enthusiasts in a relaxed setting.

events.title: Hatha Yoga – Community Session
events.description: A community-run hatha yoga session. Grounded in practice rather than commercial spirituality — a straightforward group yoga gathering for those interested in the physical and meditative practice.
events.why: Community yoga without commercial overlay — useful if you're looking for genuine peers practising movement and mindfulness.

events.title: Brisbane Language Exchange Friday
events.description: A recurring Friday night language exchange where locals and travellers meet to learn languages and share culture. Natural social gathering built around language learning and cultural curiosity.
events.why: A genuine recurring language exchange community — useful for meeting curious, internationally-minded people in an authentic learning context.

events.title: Data Science & Analytics Meetup – Brisbane Friday
events.description: A recurring casual meetup for Brisbane's data and analytics community. Informal, conversation-led gathering for technical practitioners to share knowledge and connect.
events.why: A genuine technical community for practitioners — useful if you're interested in data and analytics from a professional perspective.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane – Walking Tours
events.description: Guided walking tours exploring Brisbane's urban stories, history and architecture with professional commentary. A thoughtful way to engage with local history and urban development on foot.
events.why: A legitimate guided history tour — useful for understanding Brisbane's development and meeting fellow history-minded locals.

events.title: MJ The Musical
events.datetime: Multiple shows through 24 May (check QPAC schedule)
events.description: The multi-Tony Award–winning Broadway musical celebrating Michael Jackson's artistry, created by Christopher Wheeldon and Lynn Nottage. A polished, technically brilliant theatrical production exploring dance, music and cultural impact.
events.why: A mainstream Broadway production — technically accomplished but primarily a spectator entertainment rather than community-oriented or exploratory.

events.title: Bron Lewis – Brisbane Comedy Festival
events.location: Underground Theatre, Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
events.description: Solo comedy from Bron Lewis, an ex-high-school teacher, exploring the chaos of raising three children and juggling a burgeoning comedy career. Intimate, sharp and relatable — grounded in lived experience rather than polished persona.
events.why: Character-driven solo comedy with authentic roots in teaching — appeals to thoughtful comedy audiences, though likely sold out.
